z-m-25-09.material: Insalela R(x) uma i-polynomial P(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2) iyisisho sohlobo ax+b sezinga elingu-1 ngokuphezulu. Isisho sika-P(x) asaziwa, futhi amanye amanani omsebenzi ka-P(x) kuphela angase anikezwe. (a no-b izinombolo zangempela)

z-m-25-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ku-P(x)=(x−1)(x−2)Q(x)+ax+b, faka amanani aziwayo ka-x bese ubona ukuthi kwenzekani ethemini elinequotient Q(x).

z-m-25-08.topic: Ukusebenzisa ama-quadratic inequality: ukuhlulela isikhawu sesixazululo ngaphansi kwezimo eziguquguqukayo
z-m-25-08.goal: Bikezela ukuthi isikhawu sesixazululo se-quadratic inequality siguquka kanjani uma ulwazi esimweni luguquka, bese ubonisa umkhawulo webanga lesimo esixazululweni.

Sibheka izikhawu ezinjengesikhathi lapho ukuphakama kungu-15 m noma ngaphezulu nesikhathi lapho kungu-10 m noma ngaphansi. U-√1.2 ungu-1.095 cishe futhi u-√2 ungu-1.414 cishe.
